units.text: INT. SEAGULL - CONTINUOUS
I was singing that once when a fellow-lawyer said to me: “You have a powerful voice, sir.” Then he thought a moment and added, “But it is a disagreeable one!”
units.name: SORIN

units.text: He goes out laughing.
My father and his wife never will let me come here; they call this place Bohemia and are afraid I shall become an actress. But this lake attracts me as it does the gulls. My heart is full of you.
units.name: NINA

units.text: She glances about her.
We are alone.
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: Isn’t that some one over there?
units.name: NINA

units.text: No.
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: They kiss one another.
What is that tree?
units.name: NINA

units.text: An elm.
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: Why does it look so dark?
units.name: NINA

units.text: It is evening; everything looks dark now. Don’t go away early, I implore you.
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: I must.
units.name: NINA

units.text: What if I were to follow you, Nina? I shall stand in your garden all night with my eyes on your window.
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: That would be impossible; the watchman would see you, and Treasure is not used to you yet, and would bark.
units.name: NINA

units.text: I love you.
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: Hush!
units.name: NINA

units.text: Listening to approaching footsteps.
Who is that? Is it you, Jacob?
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: On the stage.
Yes, sir.
units.name: JACOB

units.text: To your places then. The moon is rising; the play must commence.
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: Yes, sir.
units.name: NINA

units.text: Is the alcohol ready? Is the sulphur ready? There must be fumes of sulphur in the air when the red eyes shine out.
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: To NINA.
Go, now, everything is ready. Are you nervous?
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: Yes, very. I am not so much afraid of your mother as I am of Trigorin. I am terrified and ashamed to act before him; he is so famous. Is he young?
units.name: NINA

units.text: Yes.
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: What beautiful stories he writes!
units.name: NINA

units.text: Coldly.
I have never read any of them, so I can’t say.
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: Your play is very hard to act; there are no living characters in it.
units.name: NINA

units.text: Living characters! Life must be represented not as it is, but as it ought to be; as it appears in dreams.
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: There is so little action; it seems more like a recitation. I think love should always come into every play.
units.name: NINA

units.text: NINA and TREPLIEFF go up onto the little stage; PAULINA and DORN come in.
It is getting damp. Go back and put on your goloshes.
units.name: PAULINA

units.text: I am quite warm.
units.name: DORN

units.text: You never will take care of yourself; you are quite obstinate about it, and yet you are a doctor, and know quite well that damp air is bad for you. You like to see me suffer, that’s what it is. You sat out on the terrace all yesterday evening on purpose.
units.name: PAULINA

units.text: Sings.
“Oh, tell me not that youth is wasted.”
You were so enchanted by the conversation of Madame Arkadina that you did not even notice the cold. Confess that you admire her.
units.name: PAULINA

units.text: I am fifty-five years old.
units.name: DORN

units.text: A trifle. That is not old for a man. You have kept your looks magnificently, and women still like you.
units.name: PAULINA

units.text: What are you trying to tell me?
units.name: DORN

units.text: You men are all ready to go down on your knees to an actress, all of you.
units.name: PAULINA
